en: The image shows a historic colonnade building with classical columns, a triangular pediment, and three signs above the entrance reading 'AUSGANG' (Exit), 'KREUZBRUNNEN' (Cross Spring), and 'EINGANG' (Entrance). The structure is situated in a landscaped area with benches and dense trees in the background. Architectural details are ornate with classical influences, and there are elaborate adjoining buildings. The photograph is black and white, suggesting an early 20th-century origin.
